analysis: Trial crashed with subprocess exit status 1 after 77.80 allocated GPU-seconds. No validation score was returned. The host traceback contains only the subprocess failure, so the underlying exception and failure stage remain unknown. Individual score probes and added traceback logging did not produce a successful run; batch-size-dependent score verification remains an unconfirmed hypothesis. Inspect this trial’s stderr or working/training_error.txt before choosing another fix.
code_summary: One independently trained SASRec model per category, with explicit dataset routing and one selected checkpoint loaded per category. Each model uses 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks with two attention heads, learned positions, dropout 0.3, and item biases. A jointly trained gated projection of the last five valid item embeddings augments each Transformer feature, followed by LayerNorm. Training uses sampled-softmax cross-entropy with 2,048 shared negatives, up to 2,048 target positions per batch, AdamW, learning-rate warmup, gradient clipping, and BF16 where supported. Validation selects a single checkpoint by HR@10, breaking ties with NDCG@10; no checkpoint averaging or ensemble is used. The predictor writer imports the matching architecture and verifies serialized score probes individually.
